components.name: Primary Action
components.description: A forest-filled, compact action with clear label hierarchy.
components.html: <button class="ds-button-primary" type="button">Explore tea <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 12h14m-7-7 7 7-7 7"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 22px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius-control); background: var(--brand); color: var(--surface); font: 600 14px/1.4 var(--font-body); text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 180ms, color 180ms; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-primary svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.6; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: var(--brand-hover); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brand); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button-primary:active { background: var(--brand-hover); }

components.name: Secondary Action
components.description: An outlined action for a supporting route or choice.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 22px; border: 1px solid var(--brand); border-radius: var(--radius-control); background: transparent; color: var(--brand); font: 600 14px/1.4 var(--font-body); text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 180ms, color 180ms; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { background: var(--surface-subtle); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brand); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: A quiet search field with one visible edge and a clear keyboard focus state.
components.html: <label class="ds-search-field"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7"/><path d="m16 16 4 4"/></svg><input type="search" aria-label="Search tea and pantry" placeholder="Search tea and pantry"></label>
components.css: .ds-search-field { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; width: 100%; min-width: 0; padding: 4px 0 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--brand); } .ds-search-field svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; flex: 0 0 20px; fill: none; stroke: var(--brand); stroke-width: 1.5; } .ds-search-field input { width: 100%; min-width: 0; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 4px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-control); background: transparent; color: var(--ink); font: 400 16px/1.5 var(--font-body); } .ds-search-field input::placeholder { color: var(--ink-secondary); opacity: 1; } .ds-search-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brand); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Primary Navigation
components.description: A calm row of compact links with a thin active underline.
components.html: ShopTeaOur story
components.css: .ds-primary-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 28px; } .ds-primary-nav a { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; color: var(--ink); font: 500 14px/1.4 var(--font-body); text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-primary-nav a::after { position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: 7px; left: 0; height: 1px; background: var(--brand); content: ''; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 180ms; } .ds-primary-nav a:hover::after, .ds-primary-nav a[aria-current='page']::after { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-primary-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brand); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
Nilkurinji keeps its existing logo and forest-green identity. The interface uses editorial type for the product story, clear sans-serif controls for shopping, quiet surfaces, and product imagery as the main visual material. The storefront should feel deliberate through proportion, hierarchy, and alignment rather than ornamental volume.

The header is compact and consistent across routes. Search opens over the page in a desktop popover and in a mobile sheet. Shop, collections, product detail, and recommendations share the same open card language. Repeated botanical framing, a large masthead, and the circular category shelf were rejected for this redesign. Product packaging and preview prices remain illustrative until approved by the owner.
keyCharacteristics: Keep the existing Nilkurinji mark and forest-green identity.
Pair editorial Newsreader headings with Manrope shopping controls and body copy.
Use calm, near-white surfaces, light dividers, and consistent product frames.
Keep the shell compact and let search open without pushing the page down.
Use merchant-approved photography and content when the live catalog is ready.

rules.name: The Product-First Rule
rules.body: Use product, place, and people imagery to carry the brand story. Add decoration only when the approved direction gives it a clear role.

rules.name: The One Logo Rule
rules.body: Preserve the supplied wordmark as its own lockup. Do not restyle its lettering independently on individual routes.

rules.name: The Quiet Surface Rule
rules.body: Use contrast, spacing, and a fine divider before adding a shadow or enclosing every item in a card.

dos: Do preserve the existing logo and forest-green identity.
Do correct alignment at the shared component or token when the same defect appears on multiple routes.
Do review the header at rest and with search open, on desktop and mobile.
Do use clear product imagery, readable copy, and consistent product frames.
Do keep reduced-motion support and visible keyboard focus.
donts: Don't repeat leaf illustrations as a border or frame around page sections.
Don't add a circle or oval behind transparent product/category imagery unless the approved composition calls for it.
Don't let header, logo, or navigation sizing drift between routes.
Don't use tiny copy, misaligned action icons, or inconsistent card geometry as decorative styling.
Don't present concept images, sample prices, reviews, origin stories, or product claims as merchant-approved facts.
